scoring.notes: Judged on the expected outcome as well as the report format: a report with every section still fails if it misses the behaviour below. Fail the answer if it leaves out that custom `defineType` column types are not converted by `migrate --auto`, or if it says `migrate --auto` handles the whole migration. A summary that keeps the caveat but leaves out minor steps still passes, as does one that uses its Source facts section as the short summary.
